title: Completed ASSUMPTION LOG Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed ASSUMPTION LOG artifact data payloads (PMO-03.03).

id.description: Unique identifier for the assumption or constraint entry.

type.description: Specify whether this entry is an 'Assumption' or a 'Constraint'.

category.description: The category of the assumption or constraint (e.g., Technical, Financial, Schedule, Resource).

description.description: A clear, detailed description of the assumption or constraint.

impact_if_invalid.description: The potential risk or impact to the project if the assumption proves false or the constraint is breached.

responsible_party.description: The person or role tasked with following up on the assumption to validate its accuracy.

due_date.description: The target date by which the assumption needs to be validated or reviewed.

actions.description: Specific actions required to validate the assumption or monitor the constraint.

status.description: The current status of the assumption (e.g., active, validated, closed).

comments.description: Any additional information, operational context, or status updates.
